messages.author: ruben.chavez.100297@homestead.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the new Mexico chapter space. We are setting up our local committee and planning a regional tasting for late spring.

messages.author: carlos.figueroa.102129@quillpost.example
messages.text: Thanks Mateo. The tasting lineup is shaping up nicely with entries from both Oaxaca and Querétaro.

messages.author: camila.galvan.100826@aspenholtdairy.example
messages.text: Given current public health notices, we are postponing our April gathering until further notice. Stay safe everyone.

messages.author: ruben.chavez.100297@homestead.example
messages.text: ICF staff is moving our summer educational sessions to an online format. Check your email for the connection details.

messages.author: carlos.figueroa.102129@quillpost.example
messages.text: Are we seeing any traction with the virtual symposium credentials? Several makers here are asking about the new grading tiers.

messages.author: camila.galvan.100826@aspenholtdairy.example
messages.text: Registration for the autumn virtual panels opens tomorrow through the main portal.

messages.author: ruben.chavez.100297@homestead.example
messages.text: In-person meetings are finally returning to our calendar. We are looking at a venue in Oaxaca for our autumn meet-up.

messages.author: carlos.escamilla.101054@ostergaardfarmstead.example
messages.text: The herd management seminar last week was very practical. Glad we could make the trip down.

messages.author: carlos.figueroa.102129@quillpost.example
messages.text: Competition entries for the annual exhibition are already climbing past last year's numbers.

messages.author: marco.duarte.102364@duboisfarmstead.example
messages.text: We are experiencing some capacity strain at our facility with the rise in demand. Anyone have recommendations for extra aging racks?

messages.author: elena.huerta.100160@dapplewickcreamery.example
messages.text: Marco, check with the equipment suppliers out of Querétaro, they had standard stainless steel racks in stock last month.

messages.author: ruben.chavez.100297@homestead.example
messages.text: Sponsorship holds for our regional chapter events are fully booked for the spring quarter.

messages.author: beatriz.delgado.101133@hazelcombedairy.example
messages.text: Staff is stretched pretty thin right now balancing production and these chapter hosting duties.

messages.author: ruben.chavez.100297@homestead.example
messages.text: With recent cost inflation impacting several small creameries, remember that ICF offers hardship dues relief and succession guidance.

messages.author: carlos.figueroa.102129@quillpost.example
messages.text: We lost another small producer in the northern valley last month. It is tough out there for traditional makers.

messages.author: ruben.chavez.100297@homestead.example
messages.text: Costs are starting to stabilize across the board and we are seeing good engagement from next-generation makers joining our ranks.

messages.author: emilio.mendez.100380@ottermerecenterforcheese.example
messages.text: The new raw-milk aging rule modernizations are finally clearing committee review. I will share a brief summary of the compliance changes.

messages.author: carlos.figueroa.102129@quillpost.example
messages.text: Traceability standards are the main focus for our upcoming autumn workshop in October. Make sure your batch logs are up to date.
